articles.summary: Further Margin Expansion Drove Revenue Growth GREENVILLE, S.C., Jan. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- United Community Banks, Inc. (NYSE: UCB) (United) today announced net income for the fourth quarter of 2025 of $86.5 million and pre-tax, pre-provision income of $126.3 million.
articles.title: United Community Banks, Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter Earnings
